1.text:
EMPEROR'S CHILDREN
FACTION PACK: VERSION 1.0
Legal for matched play from 20th June 2026
On the following pages you will find additional rules and clarifications that supplement your Codex, from extra detachments and
datasheets to rules updates and FAQs. All of these changes are also updated in the Warhammer 40,000 app, along with points values
for your units and detachments.
WHAT’S NEW? CONTENTS
This is the first iteration of this Faction Pack for this edition of Detachments .2
Warhammer 40,000, combining some earlier updates with new Elegant Brutes .2
revisions designed to smooth the transition. As such, all of the following Frenzied Host .3
content should be regarded as new, and individual changes are not Spectacle of Slaughter .4
highlighted. The next time this document is updated, this section will Court of the Phoenician .5
summarise what has been added or changed. Datasheets .7
Defiler .7
Rules Updates .9

10.text:
FAQS
Q: While using the Coterie of the Conceited Detachment, if my WARLORD is
not on the battlefield, can I use the Unbound Arrogance Stratagem?
A: Yes, your pledge to Slaanesh would increase from 0 to 1.
Q: Can the same enemy unit be affected by Noise Marines’ Terrifying
Crescendo ability more than once, for multiple subtractions to its Battle‑
shock and Leadership tests?
A: Yes.
Q: While using the Carnival of Excess Detachment, for the purposes of
the Daemonic Empowerment rule, if my unit already has a weapon with
[SUSTAINED HITS] (e.g. Shalaxi Helbane’s Pavane of Slaanesh, which
has [SUSTAINED HITS 3]), does an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ for such a
weapon score a Critical Hit?
A: Yes.

stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: Prideful Superiority
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

stratagems.title: Sinuous Breach
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.

stratagems.title: Close-quarters Excruciation
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model in your unit makes an attack that targets an eligible unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

stratagems.title: Euphoric Inspiration
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN DAEMON unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls for friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN units within 6" of your unit.

stratagems.title: Catalytic Stimulus
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

updates.subject: Empyric Suffusion Enhancement
updates.change: EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

updates.subject: Armour of Abhorrence Stratagem, Effect Section
updates.change: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

updates.subject: Faultless Opportunist Enhancement
updates.change: You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do: That use is -1 CP. That use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

updates.subject: On to the Next Stratagem, When and Target Sections
updates.change: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One EMPEROR’S CHILDREN unit from your army that destroyed an enemy unit this phase, and one friendly TRANSPORT it is able to embark within.

updates.subject: Mechanised Murder Detachment Rule
updates.change: Each time an EMPEROR’S CHILDREN model from your army makes an attack, if it is a TRANSPORT model or disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

updates.subject: Vengeful Surge Stratagem, Effect Section
updates.change: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is not your army’s Favoured Champions, you can re-roll the dice to determine the distance of that surge move.

updates.subject: Refusal to be Outdone Stratagem
updates.change: WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit within 12" of an engaged enemy unit declares a charge. TARGET: That EMPEROR’S CHILDREN CHARACTER unit. EFFECT: Your unit can re-roll charge rolls. Your unit must end that charge move engaged with one or more of those enemy units.

updates.subject: Chaos Spawn, Scuttling Horrors Ability
updates.change: In your opponent’s Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

updates.subject: Chaos Terminators, Lethal Obsession Ability
updates.change: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, you can use this ability. If you do, select one enemy unit hit by those ranged attacks. Until the end of the turn, when this unit declares a charge: This unit can re-roll that charge roll. This unit must end that charge move engaged with that enemy unit.

updates.subject: Fulgrim
updates.change: Add the following ability: Serpentine: Each time this model makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move over sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height.

updates.subject: Heldrake – Profile
updates.change: Change M to 12", Sv to 3+ and OC to -.

updates.subject: Chaos Land Raider and Chaos Rhino – Keywords Section

faqs.question: While using the Coterie of the Conceited Detachment, if my WARLORD is not on the battlefield, can I use the Unbound Arrogance Stratagem?
faqs.answer: Yes, your pledge to Slaanesh would increase from 0 to 1.
